voice: Warm mid-range American male voice, natural conversational pace, casual and friendly, never announcer-like.

segments.dialogue: My shoulder had been bad for about eight months. I kept telling myself it would settle.
segments.action: Mid-sentence already, relaxed, one small shrug.

segments.dialogue: I rested it for six weeks. I stretched. I did all the things people tell you.
It did nothing. And I was starting to plan my whole week around one joint.
segments.action: Glances away briefly, then back to camera.

segments.dialogue: So I stopped guessing and had someone who actually knows this stuff look at it.
They ran the bloodwork first. Then a provider read it before anything got sent out.
segments.action: Counts two points on his fingers, small and natural.

segments.dialogue: That was the whole difference for me. Somebody looked before they sold me anything.
segments.action: Settles back, easy half-smile, holds eye contact and stops.
